outcome: Verified outputs and All exceptions read from live GET /work, through one shared work-list adapter
acceptance_criteria: `/verified` calls `GET /api/v1/work?queue=verified` (no other list call) and shows one row per returned item with title, line title, owner and "Last updated" — verify: run the mock, open `/verified` at 1440 px; the network log shows that one request; the column header reads "Last updated", and the words "Verified at" appear nowhere on the page.

`/exceptions` calls `GET /api/v1/work?queue=exceptions` and no longer calls `GET /api/v1/exceptions` — verify: network log on `/exceptions`; `grep -rn "api/v1/exceptions" frontend/src` returns nothing.
Line titles come from `lines[]`; a row whose key is missing from `lines[]` shows the key — verify: unit test of the adapter with both cases; page shows "Finance ledger", not `finance-ledger/v1`.
Rows keep the server order and 8 per page; no rows-per-page control exists on either page — verify: page with 3 mock pages shows 8 rows then "Show more"; no page-size control in the DOM.

"Show more" skips empty pages: with page 2 empty and `next_page` 3, one click adds page 3's rows — verify: adapter test (`tests/work-list.test.ts`) counts the requests (`page=2`, `page=3`); after more than 10 consecutive empty pages the button reads "Keep looking" and rows already shown stay.
A first page that is empty with `next_page` set does not show the empty state; it keeps asking until rows or `next_page: null` — verify: adapter test.

The empty state shows only when there are no rows and `next_page` is null — verify: persona with an empty list shows "Nothing has been verified yet." on `/verified` and "No exceptions right now." on `/exceptions`, desktop and 390 px; with a search that matches nothing the "No … match your search." text and "Clear search" show instead.

Coverage: `as_of` always shows; `limited: true` shows "This list may be incomplete…"; non-empty `deferred` shows the deferred count line; no total, no "of N" and no "0" appears anywhere for an unknown count — verify: component test over the two fixtures above plus `limited:false,deferred:[]` (only the as-of line); text search of the rendered DOM for " of " counts and "0 " finds none.
A null `owner` shows "Unassigned" on both pages; a present owner shows the name — verify: component test, both layouts.

Exceptions state tags: `action_needed` shows "Action needed", `awaiting_reconciliation` shows "Awaiting reconciliation", `effect_uncertain` shows "Effect uncertain"; a row of any other state in the queue is shown with its own tag, not dropped — verify: component test per state; `tsc --noEmit` fails if a state is removed from the lookup.

Each title links to `/work/{id}` with the integer id and never to `django_url` or `api_url` — verify: component test reads the `href` of every row and card; navigating from a row opens the work item route.

"Open output" on a verified row reads `GET /work/{id}` and opens `output_url` in a new tab with `noopener noreferrer`; when `output_url` is null the row shows the "No output file is attached…" note; when the read fails the row shows the retry message and the rest of the list is unchanged — verify: component tests with the three mock ids; only the pressed row changes.
Rows with `sample: true` show the sample label on `/verified` — verify: component test and page at 1440 px.

The line filter narrows with `line=<key>`, search sends `q`, and either restarts from page 1; a late answer from an earlier request does not replace newer rows — verify: adapter test with a delayed first response.

Errors: 401 shows the signed-out state, 403 shows "This list isn't open to your role." with no retry, a network or 5xx failure shows the error card with Try again and the text that nothing was changed; Try again reloads — verify: component tests per status (wrong user: mock persona with 403).
A failed "Show more" keeps the rows shown and offers "Try again" — verify: adapter test.

Phone (390 px): both pages show outlined cards with the title link over the card, search plus a filter icon opening a bottom sheet; no horizontal scroll — verify: Playwright or component test at 390 px; screenshot compared with `SCR-10-mobile` and `SCR-14-mobile`.

Desktop (1440 px) layouts match `SCR-10-desktop` and `SCR-14-desktop` for the parts kept; each hidden part (see conflicts) is absent, with no blank column, empty chip or "—" placeholder in its place — verify: screenshots at 1440 px; the design fidelity tool run once because the layout changes.
Nothing writes: neither page issues a POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE — verify: network log on both pages while using search, filter, show more and open output.

The adapter's public surface (`useWorkList`, row and page types, `coverageNotes`) is exported from `src/features/work-list/index.ts` with no import from `features/exceptions` or `features/verified`, so F-63 can use it unchanged — verify: `grep -rn "features/exceptions\|features/verified" frontend/src/features/work-list` returns nothing; the adapter test passes `queue: 'needs_me'` and gets the same behaviour.

New tests exist and pass: `tests/work-list.test.ts` (adapter), `tests/verified.test.tsx`, `tests/exceptions.test.tsx` rewritten, `tests/exceptions-mock.test.ts` rewritten against the live shape, a mock test that the live shape is returned only for `verified` and `exceptions`, and that `queue=done` still returns the v7 shape — verify: `npm test` in `frontend/`.

risk.rationale: Medium: a cross-layer contract change (v7 row shape, paging and queue renames to live GET /work) in code shared with F-63, with read-only access. Surfaces ui, api, contract-change. Product acceptance is required because hidden or relabelled parts change what the client approved (screens-a-frame-core.md, SCR-10 and SCR-14).

ux.authority: reviewer-ux (lighter panel, D-180: diff and spec read, targeted code checks, no browser walk)

findings.summary: The first page is not de-duplicated by `id`, only later pages are (`useWorkList.ts` `load` versus `loadMore`). A server repeat inside one page is unlikely, so no change is needed now.

`window.open` runs after an awaited read in `VerifiedList.tsx` `OpenOutput`. Safari or a popup blocker may suppress the new tab. The spec asks for exactly this read-on-press design, so it is worth checking once against live Django.
Before "Keep looking", an empty list with `more='keep-looking'` shows "0 shown so far" in the toolbar. The 0 is a real count of loaded rows, not an unknown. Consider hiding it until rows exist.
Every "Open output" button reads the same to a screen reader; add aria-label "Open output for <title>". frontend/src/features/verified/VerifiedList.tsx (OpenOutput).
window.open runs after an awaited read, so a pop-up blocker may stop the tab. Consider opening a tab on press and setting its address after. VerifiedList.tsx:34.

Integrated QA cannot be proved: no seed or fixture file in the worktree gives a password for the local accounts live-none, live-lead, live-multi or live-admin, so no authenticated live GET /work?queue=verified or queue=exceptions, and no browser journey, could be run. Expected: a documented seed source for the test passwords (or a session the QA role may use). Actual: only 401 responses reachable. Re-run QA once credentials are available in a permitted seed or fixture file.
